name: Felbamate
metabolism: A substantial fraction is excreted unchanged in urine; the remainder includes metabolites and conjugates. Monocarbamate and hydroxylated metabolites have little contribution to anticonvulsant activity.
summary: Felbamate is an anticonvulsant used for epilepsy, including partial seizures and seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome. Because of risks of potentially fatal aplastic anemia and liver failure, its use is generally limited to severe refractory epilepsy.
